NEW_DEVICE.explanation: This payment is coming from a device we haven't seen on your account before. If this is your new phone, you can confirm it below.

NIGHT_OWL.explanation: This payment is happening very late at night. Most people don't make large transfers at this time, so we check these more carefully.

FAST_OTP.explanation: The one-time password was entered almost instantly. Banks never ask you to share or rush an OTP — if someone is guiding you on a call, please hang up and contact us.

AMOUNT_SPIKE.explanation: This amount is significantly higher than what you usually send. This is just a precaution — your payment can still go through.

ROUND_NUMBER.explanation: Fraudulent transfers are often requested in exact round numbers like ₹40,000 or ₹50,000. This pattern, combined with other signals, raised our concern.

NEW_RECIPIENT.explanation: You haven't sent money to this person or account before. We just want to double-check it's really you before continuing.

TRANSACTION_BURST.friendlyName: Several payments in a short time
TRANSACTION_BURST.explanation: Multiple transactions were made back-to-back in a short window, which can sometimes indicate unauthorized access.
